altitud de decisión

Questions and answers

What is altitud de decisión?

In this glossary, altitud de decisión refers to: Specified altitude in precision approach at which a missed approach must be initiated if runway not in sight.

How is altitud de decisión used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Piloto: pasando altitud de decisión de 300 pies, no hay pista a la vista, inicia aproximación frustrada."

Definition

Specified altitude in precision approach at which a missed approach must be initiated if runway not in sight.

Operational example

Pilot: Passing decision altitude of three hundred feet, no runway in sight, initiating missed approach.

Localized term

Localized example
